{{Quote|Gar Stazi still ''lives''. You have ''failed'' to do my Master's bidding.|Darth Azard, to Admiral Sha Dun|<ref name="leg20" />}}
'''Sha Dun''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]&mdash;the insurrection against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] led by [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] [[Roan Fel]]. By [[137 ABY]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]] had selected Dun to lead the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]], which was tasked with destroying the unified [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|fragments]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|military]] as well capturing the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Alliance [[Core Fleet]], Admiral [[Gar Stazi]]. Despite many minor victories, Dun failed to stop Stazi's attacks. [[Darth Azard]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who oversaw the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Death/Legends|executed]] Dun for the failure.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Admiral Sha Dun, you were charged by our Master, His Majesty Darth Krayt, with ending the attacks by the renegade Gar Stazi. But Gar Stazi still lives.|Darth Azard, to Admiral Dun|<ref name="leg20" />}}
[[File:AzardDun.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Azard chokes Dun with the Force.]]
The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Sha Dun served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] with the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Second Imperial Civil War|insurgency]] against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] placed Dun in charge of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]], which was overseen by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]]. In [[137 ABY]], the Outer Rim Third Fleet had been charged with capturing the fugitive [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Core Fleet]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], as well as destroying the unified fragments of the Alliance military, dubbed the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="leg20" />

Despite many minor victories, Dun failed to stop Gar Stazi's attacks. On the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command deck]] of the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']], Lord Azard executed Dun for the failure, [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifting]] and choking the Kel Dor with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], before [[Death/Legends|cutting]] the admiral down with his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].<ref name="leg20" />

Azard replaced Dun with the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] Admiral [[Dru Valan]], who had already faced Stazi during the [[Battle of Caamas]], the last major battle between the [[Fel Empire|new Galactic Empire]] and the Galactic Alliance in the [[Sith–Imperial War]], seven years previously. The Sith warned Valan not to underestimate Stazi and fail him as Dun had.<ref name="leg20" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We have come close several times, Darth Azard, and even captured or destroyed some of his ships.|Admiral Sha Dun|<ref name="leg20" />}}
An able military commander, Sha Dun was selected by Darth Krayt to lead the Imperial Outer Rim Third Fleet against the skilled Admiral Gar Stazi. Although unable to defeat Stazi, Dun was able to score many minor victories and even captured and destroyed a number of Stazi's ships. Dun had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange skin.<ref name="leg20" />

==Equipment==
As a Kel Dor, it was necessary for Dun to wear an [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath mask]]<ref name="leg20" /> for protection from [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]], and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], which were fatal to members of that [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAT">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sha Dun appeared in the twentieth issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, [[Legacy (2006) 20|''Indomitable, Part 1'']], released in [[February]] [[2008]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Omar Francia]].<ref name="leg20" />
